variants.before: Sail decimal-division.patch plus original DataFusion 54.1.0 round.rs
variants.after: Same Sail arithmetic patch plus optional datafusion-round-constant.patch

environment.dependency_override: Both variants use the same temporary path copy of datafusion-functions 54.1.0; no host dependency or lockfile changes.

cases.sql: SELECT a / b AS quotient FROM bench_input
cases.physical_plan:
ProjectionExec: expr=[CAST(round(CAST(a@0 AS Decimal128(38, 10)) / CAST(b@1 AS Decimal128(38, 2)), 13) AS Decimal128(23, 13)) as #2]
  DataSourceExec: partitions=1, partition_sizes=[128]

cases.sql: SELECT a / b AS quotient FROM bench_input
cases.physical_plan:
ProjectionExec: expr=[TRY_CAST(round(CAST(a@0 AS Decimal128(38, 10)) / CAST(nullif(CAST(b@1 AS Decimal128(12, 2)), Some(0),12,2) AS Decimal128(38, 2)), 13) AS Decimal128(23, 13)) as #2]
  DataSourceExec: partitions=1, partition_sizes=[128]
